name: Monomodule One + FX
author: sd88me
summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine as a native instrument (15 machines) plus its 7 effect machines as an audio effect, each with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links. Built by you from your own OS file.

requires_user_files.name: Monomachine OS 1.32B .syx
requires_user_files.description: Your own copy of the Monomachine OS file. Its DSP program is recompiled into your build, so the result is personal.
